title: Synaptic Plasticity & Hebbian Learning Typography
discipline: Cognitive Neuroscience · Synaptic Plasticity · Hebbian Learning · Adaptive Typography
hypothesis: Can digital typography be formulated as a living neural connectome governed by Donald Hebb's 1949 synaptic plasticity principle ('cells that fire together wire together') and Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP), where temporal co-fixation between words dynamically potentiates synaptic weight (w_ij), physically contracting kerning distances, thickening variable font stems from Hairline to Ultra-Black, and sprouting luminous dendritic axon ligatures across margins, proving that reading can transform from static consumption into an adaptive, self-organizing cognitive landscape?
